result.title: MoE-Context: Show the Model Only What It Needs
result.summary: AI agents read their whole history at every step. People do not work like that: we keep what the moment needs and hold the rest as a rough note we can recall. MoE-Context applies this to language models. The context is split into blocks. Before each step a fast yes or no pass decides which blocks the step needs; the rest stay as one-line notes that can be brought back, and nothing is deleted. In the version we build, one model makes this decision and then answers, over a single key-value cache where hidden blocks are masked rather than removed. On a laptop with Qwen3-1.7B and a synthetic lookup task, showing only the needed block raises accuracy from 93 to 119 of 120, and a masked block is as hidden as a deleted one. The model's own picking is the weak part. A supervised linear probe written into spare output rows lifts its accuracy from 80 to 110 of 120, but simple keyword search picks perfectly on this task, and the probe does not transfer to a second task. We report these results openly, along with two cheap usage patterns that block switching enables: undoing a failed attempt and running subagents without a new context.

AI.brief_summary: 将上下文切成块，每一步先用一次快速的 yes/no 判断选出所需块，其余块压缩成一行可召回笔记而不删除，并在单一 KV cache 上用掩码而非移除来隐藏块；在小型模型与合成查询任务上评估，发现模型自主挑选是薄弱环节。
AI.relevance_reason: 块级「保留/隐藏」决策与 KV cache 掩码可供核查 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选及缓存、注意力结构对 latent 相似度的干扰；其学到的选择探针不迁移、关键词检索更强的负结果，也可能提示学习式证据选择的成本与局限。
